'''''Gunship Blueprint''''' was the name of a [[Painting/Legends|blueprint]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted the design specifications for a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport]], a type of [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] commonly used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Gunship Blueprint'' was a painting in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], prior to the [[Star Wars video games|game's]] closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
